name: phi_per_OD
note: Cell volume fraction per unit OD600.

name: peri_frac
note: Periplasm as a fraction of cell volume.

name: k_mem
note: Cytoplasm-medium H2O2 exchange, P*(S/V).

name: k_scav
note: Intracellular H2O2 scavenging by KatG/KatE/AhpCF in the wild type.

name: k_scav_knockout
note: Residual scavenging in a catalase/peroxidase triple knockout (Hpx-). Used only to test whether a type-A candidate needs the knockout to pass.

name: P_endo
note: Endogenous cytoplasmic H2O2 production in a growing culture.

name: k_chem
note: Chemical H2O2 loss in the medium. Zero unless the sample matrix contributes.

name: K_oxyr
note: Cytoplasmic H2O2 at half OxyR activation.

name: n_hill
note: Hill coefficient of OxyR activation.

name: beta
note: Promoter output at full OxyR activation.

name: leak
note: Basal promoter output.

name: gfp_maturation_halflife_s
note: sfGFP maturation half-life. k_mat = ln2 / this.

name: growth_doubling_pre_s
note: Doubling time before the assay. mu_pre = ln2 / this.

name: growth_doubling_s
note: Doubling time during the assay. mu = ln2 / this.

name: cv_reader
note: Relative SD of a single fluorescence measurement.

name: n_rep
note: Technical replicates.

name: creatinine_MW_g_per_mol
note: Molar mass of creatinine. Converts creatinine g/L to mol/L for the per-mol-creatinine units.

name: hill_n_binding
note: Hill coefficient assumed for module types B and C. Modelling assumption, not a measured constant: 1.0 means non-cooperative single-site binding. No source reports a Hill coefficient for any sensor in sensors.csv.

name: z_required
note: Z needed to call two fluorescence readings separable at the reader.

name: auc_pass_min
note: Reported AUC at or above which stage 1 passes on the AUC route.

name: p_pass_max
note: Two-sided Welch p below which stage 1 can pass on the statistics route.

name: cohens_d_pass_min
note: Absolute Cohen's d required alongside the p-value. Both are needed, so a tiny effect at huge n does not pass.

name: sd_over_value_max
note: Applies only to an SD reconstructed from a range or an IQR. If that SD exceeds the central value by more than this, the strictly positive quantity cannot be anywhere near normal, the reconstruction is not trustworthy, and the row is called insufficient rather than failed. A spread the authors reported directly as an SD or SEM is never second-guessed this way.

name: conc_factor_max
note: Largest sample concentration factor considered achievable. Above this a candidate is red rather than yellow.

name: kd_ratio_lo
note: Analyte/Kd below this is called below-Kd: the sensor sits in its dead zone.

name: kd_ratio_hi
note: Analyte/Kd above this is called saturated.

name: conversion_target
note: Fraction of the analyte that must be turned over inside the read time. Sets the minimum enzyme loading reported by the enzyme comparison.

name: knockout_gain_min
note: Relative fold improvement a scavenger knockout must give before it is called helpful, rather than noise in the integration.
